themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, including planning, execution, and interaction with research environments.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrating with IDEs or specific platforms.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Examines how AI is integrated into product development workflows, from ideation and research to feature prioritization and roadmap planning.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and applications designed to facilitate and accelerate various stages of the research process.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or personas to simulate real user behavior for testing and research.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI applications that directly aid in the design process or bridge the gap between design and user research insights.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Details how AI is used to process, analyze, and extract insights from large datasets, often for user behavior or market research.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze user feedback, reviews, and social media to understand sentiment and extract qualitative insights.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers AI applications for automating or enhancing usability testing processes, including evaluation and report generation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and employment landscapes within various industries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
